category_edits.rationale: Normalize input item embeddings by RMS with epsilon 1e-6 and no affine parameters to stabilize GRU input scales. Preserve zero padding and unchanged output embeddings, scoring, GRU topology, loss, and optimizer. The generated predictor imports GRU4RecModel from train.py, so it automatically uses the same normalization without checkpoint changes.
